description: Run the Aegis mutation harness: prove isolation on a fresh branch, then break each guarantee on purpose (FORCE RLS removed, a policy made USING (true), a WITH CHECK dropped) on throwaway branches and require every break to be caught. Returns an apply token only when the baseline is safe and no mutant slipped through. Use this before schema.apply or merging a preview branch, and confirm with the user first.
name: policy.test
